description: Canonical, versioned VisualFX scene configuration. Roblox values use the tagged encodings in Core/Serialization.luau.

Inherits.description: Preset names merged left to right.

Quality.description: Quality level and performance budget overrides.

Lighting.description: Lighting service properties: time of day, brightness, ambient colors, shadows.

ColorShiftBottom.description: Tint of surfaces facing away from the sun.

ColorShiftTop.description: Tint of surfaces facing the sun.

EnvironmentDiffuseScale.description: Ambient light derived from the sky.

EnvironmentSpecularScale.description: Specular reflections derived from the sky (also affects water/metal).

FogColor.description: Legacy fog color (ignored while an Atmosphere exists).

FogEnd.description: Legacy fog end distance (ignored while an Atmosphere exists).

FogStart.description: Legacy fog start distance (ignored while an Atmosphere exists).

Technology.description: Lighting technology. Usually only writable from Studio; skipped with a warning elsewhere.

Atmosphere.description: Atmospheric scattering, distance fog and haze.

Density.description: How much light the air absorbs (distance fog).

Offset.description: Light transmission between camera and sky (horizon silhouette).

SkyboxOrientation.description: Skybox rotation in degrees (newer engines only).

Cover.description: Fraction of the sky covered by clouds.

Water.description: Terrain water appearance and the underwater look.

Area.description: Size of the emission volume in studs.

Attach.description: Follow the local camera or stay at Position.

CullDistance.description: Disable when the camera is farther than this (World attach). Defaults to the quality profile.

Offset.description: Offset from the camera when Attach = Camera.

Position.description: World position of the emission volume (World attach, or server fallback).

Priority.description: Higher priority systems keep their budget first when quality limits apply.

Rate.description: Particles emitted per second (before quality scaling).

Particles.description: Named particle systems. Keys are system names; values are template overrides.

Weather.description: High-level weather composed of atmosphere, lighting, clouds, particles, wind, fog, lightning and audio hooks.

Area.description: Size of the emission volume in studs.

Attach.description: Follow the local camera or stay at Position.

CullDistance.description: Disable when the camera is farther than this (World attach). Defaults to the quality profile.

Offset.description: Offset from the camera when Attach = Camera.

Position.description: World position of the emission volume (World attach, or server fallback).

Priority.description: Higher priority systems keep their budget first when quality limits apply.

Rate.description: Particles emitted per second (before quality scaling).

Particles.description: Per-component particle overrides or extra components.

Area.description: Emission volume size for weather particles.

Fog.description: Extra fog on top of the weather type.

Position.description: Center of weather particles when Attach = World.

RainIntensity.description: Overrides Intensity for the Rain component.

SnowIntensity.description: Overrides Intensity for the Snow component.

Environment.description: Wind, day/night cycle and spatial effect zones.

DriveLighting.description: Interpolate brightness/ambient/atmosphere colors through built-in sunrise/sunset keyframes.

Effect.description: Particle template for the zone (Fog, Mist, Dust, Leaves, Fireflies, Rain, Snow, ...).

Atmosphere.description: Atmosphere values blended in while the camera is inside.

Density.description: How much light the air absorbs (distance fog).

Offset.description: Light transmission between camera and sky (horizon silhouette).

BlendDistance.description: Distance over which Atmosphere overrides fade in around the zone.

CullDistance.description: Disable the zone beyond this camera distance (defaults to the quality profile).

Overrides.description: ParticleEmitter overrides for the zone's emitter.

Rate.description: Particles emitted per second (before quality scaling).

Zones.description: Spatial effect zones keyed by name.

Effect.description: Registered effect name (defaults to the entry key).

Effects.description: Instances of custom effect types registered with VisualFX:RegisterEffect.
